notes.title: v1.04 Skyblocker update
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where cursor could disappear after returning to the main menu
-Optimization of wind physics on blocks
-Improved detection of tower height
-Added option to change anti-aliasing method
-Slightly lowered controller sensitivity and adjusted response curve to be much smoother when using a gamepad
